changeinfo.changes: - Expanded USB audio capture support for games, homebrew, emulators, and system audio. - Improved capture of sound effects and mixed audio sources. - Added adaptive support for 44.1 kHz and 48 kHz audio. - Added an optional screen-off streaming mode for both OLED and LCD PS Vita models. - The display now follows the USB connection status while using screen-off mode. - Prevented automatic standby while streaming. - Improved USB reconnection, shutdown behavior, compatibility, and overall stability. - Added HomebrewUpdate detection and guided installation to the control application.
